title: lansium decandrum
intro: Lansium decandrum, commonly known as the five-angled Lansium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The plant is reported to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential applications of Lansium decandrum.
